purpose: Offline supplemental examples for bundled vocabulary that has no valid example sentence.
generationPolicy: One concise, natural English usage sentence containing the headword or a normal grammatical inflection, plus a Simplified Chinese translation.
fallbackNote: 58 entries were reviewed and corrected for incomplete translations or unnatural usage.
reviewNote: The original pack includes 58 reviewed corrections. Of the 321 examples added on 2026-10-04, 320 were machine-generated and one spelling-sensitive entry was manually written; several entries were lightly edited. The new set has not received full expert editorial review.
preparationModel: Qwen3 4B (used only to prepare static data; no model code or runtime dependency is included)
